title: Page 141
transc:
FT Bickford  Washn August 1st 1864
Gertrude Brown for Palermo In gals Vermont tulip
Despatches of yesterday recd and all weasel fit
for swingling pedlar & Sugar now in service
& not other wise employed at Hunter Bard mar
Grammar & Girdle yesterday repeated to Brimstone yard
No new charters repeated stop Is this what
is wanted or is the surgery extensive &
does it need new & further provision of
vessels wind Buggy man a strange animal &c


230 Pm
Beckwith (No 2)  Wash. D. C. Aug 2. 1864
City Pt
Henrietta Brooks for chart tulip Grover's princeton of morgan pelton
landed last night & has N pauline on the weak
Knees Wheedle Rocke ville ---- A few Cos of Torberts
pedlar are arriving ---- The Weasel of widows in small
Waltzers is slow <deletion>withdraw</deletion> <insertion>Translate</insertion> & I presume that several days
will elapse before Negus Queen is all landed ---- as
it now stands Watkins prospects the Dawson pelton pike Emory
the Morgan pick Augusta the wedge of quotient of Walker
Bermuda & lafitte & Duffy the pekin pickerel meriden being
in shark prospect talbot whole ---- If Negus is not
placed in spark princeton I think he shld take all
the pekin but not the Dawson pelham ---- To make
